title: 第9章 封印第10章 灵石火晶灵药
lines: “咔嚓！”
长刀收阻，断成两截！
而那挥刀斩向许辰的唐家子弟，身躯一震，低头看去，半截刀刃竟然直插胸膛。
他竟然死在自己的兵器之下。
在众人吃惊的目光注视之下，那人带着不甘，缓缓倒地。
唐莫微微怔神，他没想到，一个其貌不扬的少年，竟然敢杀唐家之人。
他神色冷然，眼中杀意涌动。
“剁了他！”
一声令下，唐家子弟纷纷拔出刀剑，从四面八方杀向许辰。
唐家子弟多是练气境，人数众多，但对许辰却并无多少威胁。
许辰身子一晃，消失在了原地，呼啸而来的攻击全部落空。
几乎同一时间，许辰神不知鬼不觉欺身一人面前，在其错愕的目光注视之下，手捏拳印，一拳笔直轰出。
“咔嚓！”
脑袋犹如西瓜一般炸开。
鲜血飞溅。
无头尸体晃了晃，直挺挺倒地。
一个照面再杀一人。
动作干净利落。
丝毫不拖泥带水。
灵力涌入右腿之中，猛地抽出，砰的一声，一名凝气境一重武者腰部炸开一团血雾，而且身体也如断线纸鸢，不受控制倒飞了出去。
此时此刻，许辰犹如下山猛虎，无人可挡。
呼吸之间。
唐家子弟已是三死二伤。
唐莫看着那犹如杀神般的许辰眼皮跳了跳，“杜重，此人棘手，你我两家联手，杀了此人，然后灵液平分，你看怎么样？”
意识到许辰的威胁后，唐莫竟要和杜重联手。
杜重此刻却是一脸冷笑，拒绝唐莫联手的提议，“此人与我杜家无冤无仇，我为什么要与你联手？”
唐莫气急。
他恶狠狠的看了杜重一眼，然后抽出长刀，灵力暴涌间，一刀劈出，凌厉的刀气劈开空气，发出尖锐的破空声，欲把许辰当头劈成两截。
声嘶力竭的吼声，自其口中传出。
content_en:
"Bang!"
"Crack!"
The long knife was blocked and broken into two pieces!
The Tang family boy who slashed at Xu Chen with his sword was shocked. When he looked down, half of the blade was inserted straight into his chest.
He actually died under his own weapon.
Under the surprised gazes of everyone, the man slowly fell to the ground with unwillingness.
Tang Mo was slightly startled. He didn't expect that a young man with a humble appearance would dare to kill a member of the Tang family.
His expression was cold, and murderous intent surged in his eyes.
"Chop him!"
At the command, the Tang family's children drew their swords one after another and attacked Xu Chen from all directions.
Most of the disciples of the Tang family were in the Qi training realm and there were many of them, but they did not pose much of a threat to Xu Chen.
Xu Chen swayed and disappeared on the spot, and all the roaring attacks failed.
Almost at the same time, Xu Chen unknowingly appeared in front of a man. Under his astonished gaze, he made a fist seal with his hand and punched straight out.
"Crack!"
His head exploded like a watermelon.
Blood splattered.
The headless corpse shook and fell straight to the ground.
Kill one person after another.
The movements are clean and crisp.
Not sloppy at all.
"Bang!"
"Poof!"
Spiritual energy poured into his right leg, and he pulled it out suddenly. With a bang, a cloud of blood mist exploded from the waist of a first-level Qi Condensation Realm warrior, and his body flew out uncontrollably like a paper kite with its string cut off.
At this moment, Xu Chen was like a tiger descending the mountain, unstoppable.
Between breaths.
Three of the Tang family's children were dead and two injured.
Tang Mo's eyelids twitched as he looked at Xu Chen who looked like a murderous god, "Du Zhong, this person is a troublesome person. You and I will join forces to kill this person, and then the spiritual liquid will be divided equally. What do you think?"
After realizing Xu Chen's threat, Tang Mo actually wanted to join forces with Du Zhong.
Du Zhong had a sneer on his face at this moment, rejecting Tang Mo's proposal to join forces, "This person has no enmity with my Du family, why should I join forces with you?"
"You..."
Tang Mo was furious.
He gave Du Zhong a vicious look, then pulled out his long knife, and with a sudden surge of spiritual power, he slashed out with the knife. The sharp sword energy split the air, making a sharp sound of breaking through the air, trying to split Xu Chen's head in two.
"Death!"
A hoarse roar came from his mouth.
